mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_user(user_id, password, username) VALUES (#{user.userId}, #{user.password}, #{user.username})
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar FROM chat_user u WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND password = #{password}
SELECT u.user_id As userId, u.username, u.password, u.create_time AS createTime, u.avatar FROM chat_friend f JOIN chat_user u ON u.user_id = f.friend_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_friend WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId}
